description: The plot illustrates the variations in precision, recall, and F1-score across different model variants of MS-FSLHate on the HateXplain dataset. The x-axis represents the 'Model Variants' with nominal categories: 'Full model (Ours)', 'w/o Prompt', 'w/o Augmentation', 'w/o Attention', and 'w/o Prompt & Augmentation'. The y-axis represents 'Metric (%)' with a linear scale, ranging from 58 to 66, marked at intervals of 2%. The purple line, representing 'Precision,' uses circles as markers and a solid line style, starting at approximately 65.49% with the 'Full model (Ours)', decreasing to 61.06% for 'w/o Prompt', then increasing to 63.7% for 'w/o Augmentation', further increasing to 64.06% for 'w/o Attention', and finally reaching 65.44% for 'w/o Prompt & Augmentation'. The blue line signifies 'Recall,' featuring circles and a solid line, beginning at 65.78% for 'Full model (Ours)', dropping sharply to 59.64% with 'w/o Prompt,' increasing to 62.63% for 'w/o Augmentation', decreasing to 59.17% for 'w/o Prompt & Augmentation'. The brown line illustrates the 'F1-score' using circles and a solid line, starting at 65.56%, decreasing to 60.16% for 'w/o Prompt', increasing to 62.22% for 'w/o Augmentation', then decreasing to 59.67% for 'w/o Attention', and finally reaching 57.74% with 'w/o Prompt & Augmentation'.
caption_used: Ablation study on the HateXplain dataset. The line chart illustrates variations in precision, recall, and F1-score across different model variants of MS-FSLHate. The x-axis represents the 'Model Variants', labeled as nominal categories: 'Full model (Ours)', 'w/o Prompt', 'w/o Augmentation', 'w/o Attention', and 'w/o Prompt & Augmentation'. The y-axis represents 'Metric (%)' with a linear scale, ranging from 58 to 66, marked at intervals of 2%. The purple line, representing 'Precision,' uses circles as markers and a solid line style. It starts at approximately 65.45% with the 'Full model (Ours)' and shows a consistent decline across the variants, reaching its lowest point at 57.74% for 'w/o Prompt & Augmentation'. The blue line signifies 'Recall,' featuring circles and a solid line. It begins at 65.78% for 'Ours', drops sharply to 59.64% with 'w/o Prompt,' and continues to decline steadily, reaching 56.82% at 'w/o Prompt & Augmentation.' The brown line illustrates the 'F1-score' using circles and a solid line, starting at 65.16%, decreasing to 60.16% for 'w/o Prompt', and showing a slight increase at 'w/o Augmentation' before dropping again to 57.74% with 'w/o Prompt & Augmentation'. There is a legend on the bottom left of the plot to infer the line color from their labels.
